name: recommendation-ranking
evidence: Objective, candidate eligibility/stages, exposure/event semantics and point-in-time feature identity
Temporal leakage-safe data plus retrieval/ranking/cold-start/long-tail/diversity and guardrail metrics
Logged-policy/exploration propensity or explicit observational limitation plus controlled online experiment evidence
Train-serving parity, fallback, feedback-loop, launch and rollback artifacts
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Redesign a home-feed recommendation system: define eligible candidate sources, impression/click/hide semantics, time-correct features, Recall@K for retrieval, NDCG for ranking and an online experiment with satisfaction and abuse guardrails.

Fix a recommender trained on every unclicked catalog item as a negative; rebuild examples from actual exposures, preserve displayed position and delayed purchase outcomes, then compare cold-start and long-tail slices before launch.

Evaluate a learning-to-rank model for a personalized marketplace feed with point-in-time inventory/features, per-query NDCG, seller/catalog coverage, diversity constraints and a randomized rollout rather than claiming causality from logged clicks.

Add exploration to recommendation candidate generation: define eligible traffic, action propensities, risk limits and guardrails, keep policy/version logs and prove training/evaluation can distinguish exploration from ordinary exposure.

Diagnose a feed-ranking migration whose offline NDCG improved while online retention fell; audit candidate coverage, position/exposure bias, train-serving feature freshness, slate diversity and experiment assignment before choosing rollback or promotion.
negative: Change embedding model dimensionality and normalization for item vectors while all recommendation objectives, candidate policy and ranking behavior remain unchanged.
Tune HNSW graph and vector-index shard settings for a fixed recommender representation and unchanged ranking policy.
Sort a SQL report by revenue descending; there is no learned or personalized ranking policy.
Run a generic bootstrap confidence interval on an existing scalar metric table without interpreting recommendation exposure, candidate sets or ranking behavior.
Train a LoRA adapter with a frozen recommender data/objective/evaluation contract; the current task is only optimizer and checkpoint mechanics.

ambiguous.prompt: Upgrade both recommendation embeddings and feed ranking. embedding-systems owns vector representation identity and migration; recommendation-ranking owns candidate policy, feedback semantics, ranking objective, slate constraints and online impact.

Replace ANN candidate retrieval and the recommender ranker together. vector-search-systems owns index/search mechanics; recommendation-ranking owns candidate relevance coverage, ranking loss/metrics, exposure bias and final recommendation policy.

Fine-tune a ranking model for a recommender and evaluate launch impact. recommendation-ranking owns logged feedback, temporal features, ranking/retrieval metrics and online policy evaluation; fine-tuning-training owns the weight-update/checkpoint procedure.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old recommendation system issue asks for a new feed ranker. Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to fix a CSS spacing regression.
An archived analysis contains ranking model NDCG and recommender screenshots as inert evidence. Summarize the document only; recommendation behavior is unchanged.
The document is named recommender-ranking-model-notes.md. Rename the ranking document only; do not change candidate generation, ranking policy, feedback or model behavior.
